events.name: Bomb Rain
events.desc: Bombs fall from high up. Get under cover.

events.name: Rupoor Rain
events.desc: Rupoors rain down. Each one costs rupees.

events.name: Blood Moon
events.desc: A horde of one enemy type from your pool.

events.name: Joke Event
events.desc: Harmless critters flood the area.

events.name: Moonfall
events.desc: Boulders land where you're heading. Turn!

events.name: The Stalker
events.desc: Something hunts you and hits very hard.

events.name: Phantom Army
events.desc: Invisible soldiers. The Lens shows them.

events.name: Treasure Hunt
events.desc: Find the hidden rupee in time or be frozen.

events.name: Blood Hunger
events.desc: Your health drains. Every kill heals you.

events.name: Searchlights
events.desc: Avoid the spotlights or enemies come.

events.name: Terrible Fate
events.desc: Salesmen creep closer when you look away.

events.name: Red Light Green Light
events.desc: Freeze when the moon watches or get zapped.

events.name: Echo
events.desc: A ghost walks your path. One touch kills.

events.name: Champion Duel
events.desc: Duel a champion. Beat it to move on.

events.name: Time Moves w/ You
events.desc: Stand still and time stops. So does its clock.

events.name: Carpenter Uprising
events.desc: Rainbow carpenters attack. Hit them to stop.

events.name: Procession of the Dead
events.desc: A column of ReDeads marches. Don't cross it.

events.name: Mirage
events.desc: Tough foes come with fakes. Find the real ones.

events.name: Mirror Dance
events.desc: Dancers copy your every move.

events.name: Tingle Air Raid
events.desc: Tingle drops bombs. Pop his balloon to stop him.

events.name: Cursed Tag
events.desc: Hit an enemy to pass the curse before it blows.

events.name: Pop Quiz
events.desc: Four questions. Wrong costs half your hearts.

events.name: Low Gravity
events.desc: Low gravity: you jump higher and fall slowly.

events.name: Moonlit Prey
events.desc: Kill both glowing foes for rupees, or get hurt.

events.name: Starfall Bounty
events.desc: Stand where the stars land!

events.name: Dowsing Moon
events.desc: Follow the warmth, press A to dig.

events.name: Giant's Gale
events.desc: Hold the stick INTO the wind.

events.name: Sinking Sands
events.desc: Keep moving!

events.name: Frostbite
events.desc: Roll to shake off the frost.

events.name: Scythe Sweep
events.desc: Hop it (Z+A) or stand in the gap.

events.name: Moth Swarm
events.desc: Spin attack to scatter the moths!

events.name: Hex of Silence
events.desc: Don't press B or the C buttons.

events.name: Moon Tether
events.desc: Stay inside the drifting circle!

events.name: Moon's Grasp
events.desc: When it grabs you, MASH A!

events.name: Heartbeat Hex
events.desc: Press A on every heartbeat.

events.name: Moon's Reflex Test
events.desc: Press the button that flashes up!

events.name: Gorgon's Gaze
events.desc: Keep your camera AWAY from the eye.

events.name: Dissonance
events.desc: Play any 3 ocarina notes.

events.name: Mirror Madness
events.desc: Face the shard, hold Z to break it.

events.name: Volley of Stars
events.desc: Face the star and hold R to guard!

events.name: Sleeping Giant
events.desc: Tiptoe! Running wakes the giant.

events.name: Mask Salesman's Game
events.desc: Watch the arrows, repeat on D-pad.

events.name: Pressure Seals
events.desc: Step on the seals in order.

traits.name: Armored
traits.desc: Takes half damage from every hit.

traits.name: Coward
traits.desc: At 30% health it flees, then returns healed.

traits.name: Summoner
traits.desc: Calls in extra enemies every 12 seconds.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.desc: Burns you if you get too close.

traits.name: Blinker
traits.desc: Teleports near you if you keep your distance.

traits.name: Moonblessed
traits.desc: Can't be hurt while an event is running.

traits.name: Vengeful
traits.desc: Drops a bomb from the sky when it dies.

traits.name: Mark-Hungry
traits.desc: Hits harder the more Moon Marks you carry.

traits.name: Splitter
traits.desc: Splits into two copies when slain.

traits.name: Enraged
traits.desc: Faster and hits harder below half health.

traits.name: Thorned
traits.desc: Stings you back when you hit it with a sword.

traits.name: Frostbrand
traits.desc: Its hits chill you: your stick goes half as far.

traits.name: Thief
traits.desc: Steals 3 Marks per hit. A bounty pays back double, a Nemesis never.

traits.name: Cloaked
traits.desc: Keeps fading out of sight. Lens reveals it.

muts.name: Reinforcements
muts.desc: Kills may call in a replacement enemy.

muts.name: Elite Foes
muts.desc: 1 in 4 enemies has a random trait.

muts.name: Heart Lock
muts.desc: You can't heal within 2 hearts of your max.

muts.name: Open Wounds
muts.desc: After a hit, you can't heal for 10 seconds.

muts.name: Ammo Tax
muts.desc: Arrows, bombs, nuts and sticks go twice as fast.

muts.name: Butterfingers
muts.desc: Every hit you take costs 10 rupees.

muts.name: Restless Earth
muts.desc: Stand still 4 seconds and a boulder falls on you.

muts.name: Emboldened
muts.desc: Your Nemesis fights with +3 in every stat.

muts.name: Hunted
muts.desc: Your Nemesis turns up far more often.

muts.name: Ambushers
muts.desc: New areas may greet you with enemies.

muts.name: Keese Escort
muts.desc: A few Keese follow you everywhere.

curses.name: Twin Omens
curses.desc: Combo events are much more common.

curses.name: Moon's Favorite
curses.desc: One event comes up half the time.

curses.name: Blood Nights
curses.desc: A Blood Moon rises every night at 6 PM.

curses.name: Silent Moon
curses.desc: No warning or roulette before events.

curses.name: Glass Moon
curses.desc: You take double damage during events.

curses.name: Encore
curses.desc: Every event comes back a minute later.

curses.name: Bell Toll
curses.desc: Events strike every 3 hours on the clock.

pouch.name: Portal Stones
pouch.desc: Place two, then step in one to hop to the other.

pouch.name: Giga Blade
pouch.desc: Arm it: your next 10 sword hits do triple damage.

pouch.name: Gravity Bomb
pouch.desc: Pulls enemies together, then blows them up.

pouch.name: Second Wind
pouch.desc: Automatic: a killing blow leaves you at 4 hearts.

pouch.name: Moon Shield
pouch.desc: Raise it: it absorbs your next hits.

pouch.name: Nemesis Brand
pouch.desc: The next roaming enemy you hurt becomes your Nemesis.

pouch.name: Nemesis Compass
pouch.desc: 60 seconds: shows where your Nemesis is.

pouch.name: Smoke Veil
pouch.desc: Enemies lose track of you for 10 seconds.

pouch.name: Stillwater Charm
pouch.desc: Ends the event that's running. No reward.

pouch.name: Moon Dash
pouch.desc: Blink forward along the ground, through enemies.

stats.name: Health
stats.desc: More health (+25% of its base per point).

stats.name: Tracking
stats.desc: Finds them faster and turns up more often. At 8 it follows them through doors.

uniques.name: Second Skin
uniques.desc: The first hit each fight does nothing.

uniques.name: Undying
uniques.desc: Lives through a killing blow once per fight.

uniques.name: Colossus
uniques.desc: Twice as big, can't be knocked back, regenerates.

uniques.name: Shatter
uniques.desc: Its hits drain magic. It breaks your guard.

uniques.name: Executioner
uniques.desc: Below a third of your health, any hit kills you.

uniques.name: Lunge
uniques.desc: Dashes at you from mid range.

uniques.name: Afterimage
uniques.desc: Dodges your first swing every few seconds.

uniques.name: Blitz
uniques.desc: Two quick strikes per attack, twice as fast.

uniques.desc: Sends 2 Recon Keese at you every 2 minutes.

uniques.name: Bloodscent
uniques.desc: When you get hurt, it moves one area closer.

uniques.desc: In your area, it appears on you and attacks.
